name: Saliency-based Opacity Modulation
definition: An automated technique to enhance volume visualization by modifying the transfer function (opacity) based on computed voxel saliency values to guide viewer attention.
summary: Saliency-based Opacity Modulation is a data-driven technique that enhances volume visualization by making less important regions transparent while preserving salient parts, distinguishing itself from static transfer functions through its reliance on spatial importance maps.
